title: Answering every property lead in under a minute
summary: A brokerage buying portal and Meta leads was calling them back hours later. We built a GoHighLevel system with instant replies, an AI voice agent that qualifies and books viewings, and agent routing by area.
problem: Leads arrived from three property portals, Meta lead ads and the website, each into a different inbox. Agents called back when they had time, often the next day, and there was no record of who had spoken to whom. The owner could see ad spend going up, but not which leads became viewings or sales.
built: One GoHighLevel pipeline fed by every portal, Meta lead ads and website forms, with the source tagged on each lead
An instant SMS and WhatsApp reply on every new lead, day or night
A Retell AI voice agent that calls new leads within minutes, asks budget, area and timeline, and books a viewing into the right agent's calendar
Round-robin assignment by area, with missed-call text back on every agent's number
A seven-day nurture sequence for leads that don't book, stopping the moment they reply
A dashboard of response time, viewings booked and deals won by lead source
